tooltip_definitions.Data Center Revenue: Accelerated computing GPU platforms (Instinct MI300X, MI325X, MI350, Helios rackscale) and enterprise server CPUs (EPYC Turin and 6th Gen Venice). Grew +96.9% YoY to $8,546M in Q3 2026.
tooltip_definitions.Client Business: Personal computing microprocessors powering commercial notebooks and consumer desktop systems (Ryzen AI processors with integrated NPU). Generated $2,949M in Q3 2026.
tooltip_definitions.Gaming Business: Radeon discrete graphics cards and custom semi-custom SoC silicon for gaming consoles including Sony PlayStation 5 and Microsoft Xbox Series X/S ($773M in Q3 2026).
tooltip_definitions.Embedded Segment: Adaptive SoCs, FPGAs, System-on-Modules (SOMs), and embedded x86 processors serving aerospace, defense, industrial automation, and automotive markets ($1,109M in Q3 2026).
tooltip_definitions.Helios Rackscale Architecture: AMD's flagship AI supercomputing rack architecture integrating Instinct MI450 GPUs and 6th Gen EPYC Venice CPUs, adopted by Anthropic, OpenAI, Meta, and Microsoft.
tooltip_definitions.Instinct MI450 Series: Next-generation 2nm/3nm accelerated GPU silicon delivering industry-leading FP8/FP4 AI inference and training throughput with advanced high-bandwidth memory (HBM4).
tooltip_definitions.EPYC Server Microprocessors: Fifth-generation Turin (Zen 5) and sixth-generation Venice high-core-count enterprise server CPUs driving steady cloud and on-premise market share gains vs. Intel Xeon.
tooltip_definitions.Non-GAAP Gross Margin: Adjusted gross margin excluding stock-based compensation, intangible amortization, and acquisition adjustments (reached 56.0% in Q3 2026, beating 55.0% consensus).
tooltip_definitions.GAAP Operating Income: Income from operations under U.S. GAAP ($2,832M in Q3 2026, surging +123% YoY with operating margin expanding 700 bps to 21.17%).
tooltip_definitions.Non-GAAP Operating Income: Operating earnings excluding non-cash stock compensation and acquisition amortizations ($3,923M in Q3 2026, up +75.3% YoY with a 29.33% margin).
tooltip_definitions.Non-GAAP Diluted EPS: Adjusted earnings per share excluding acquisition-related amortization and stock compensation ($2.09 in Q3 2026 vs $1.93 Street consensus, a +8.29% beat).
tooltip_definitions.GAAP Diluted EPS: Net income per diluted share under U.S. GAAP ($1.46 in Q3 2026 vs $1.38 Street consensus, +5.80% beat).
tooltip_definitions.ROCm Open Software Ecosystem: AMD's open-source accelerated computing software stack (ROCm 10 with ROCm.AI) providing day-zero support for PyTorch, vLLM, Triton, and major frontier foundation models.
tooltip_definitions.True Free Cash Flow: Forensic cash generation deducting capital expenditures ($648M) and stock-based compensation ($1,152M) from operating cash flow ($1,202M), leaving -$598M economic cash.
tooltip_definitions.World Labs Acquisition: Strategic acquisition of Fei-Fei Li's World Labs Technologies for $8.2B in common stock to lead research in large world models (LWMs) and spatial AI computing.
tooltip_definitions.Taalas Acquisition: Strategic transaction acquiring proprietary direct-to-silicon inference ASIC technology to optimize high-volume, low-latency enterprise AI inference systems.
tooltip_definitions.Operating Cash Flow: Cash generated by core semiconductor design and licensing operations ($1,202M in Q3 2026, absorbing seasonal inventory build and foundry prepayment obligations).
tooltip_definitions.Capital Expenditures: Cash reinvested in high-density engineering compute clusters, test equipment, and mask set tooling ($648M in Q3 2026).
tooltip_definitions.Reported Free Cash Flow: Operating cash flow minus capital expenditures ($554M delivered in Q3 2026).
tooltip_definitions.Full-Year Guidance Surge: Upward revision of Q4 2026 revenue guidance to approximately $17.0B ± 3% (representing ~66% YoY growth), catapulting full-year top line above $48.5B.
